title: Restriction of the extended proof at lifted addresses
statement: Let $V$ be a system with Boolean input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and a finite random seed space, and let $K\in\mathbb N$. For every input word $w\colon\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\mathrm{Bool}$, extended proof word $q\colon\mathrm{Fin}(\ell+K|S|)\to\mathrm{Bool}$, and address in the disjoint union of input and proof addresses, evaluating the word formed from $w$ and $q$ at the lifted address gives the same value as evaluating the word formed from $w$ and the restriction of $q$ to its first $\ell$ positions at the original address; here $|S|$ is the number of seeds of $V$.
